scripts.dev: docker compose up -d db && concurrently "yarn dev:frontend" "yarn dev:backend"
scripts.install:all: yarn install && cd frontend && yarn install && cd ../backend && yarn install
scripts.sonar: cd frontend && npx eslint . && cd ../backend && npx eslint "{src,apps,libs,test}/**/*.ts"
scripts.typecheck: yarn --cwd frontend tsc --noEmit && yarn --cwd backend tsc --noEmit
